episodes.synopsis: Heroic Michel Volban leads the People’s Army on a march toward freedom. But unless a hero arrives to join the fight, the rebellion stands little chance against the might of the Imperial Fleet.
episodes.title: Like a Shooting Star

episodes.synopsis: All seems lost for the People’s Army until the arrival of a sleek battleship bearing the crest of the Royal Family! Hope dissipates when these saviors turn out to be no better than pirates.
episodes.title: Like the Wind

episodes.synopsis: On a desolate planet populated by the scum of the universe, Michel follows Cleo into the mountains and challenges him to a duel.
episodes.title: Like Destiny

episodes.synopsis: After Cleo crosses swords with Vetti Sforza in a dusty tavern, the duel spills into the streets and continues in the skies. Escape seems hopeless when the Imperial Fleet arrives.
episodes.title: Like Scars

episodes.synopsis: The pirates give the Imperial Fleet a taste of the Royal Family’s technology. With a truce reached between Cleo and Michel, a course is set for the stronghold of the People’s Army.
episodes.title: Like a Mask

episodes.synopsis: A battle-damaged transport ship carries a surprise: Michel’s long missing brother. Reeling from shock, the wounded man claims no knowledge of the sibling standing before him.
episodes.title: Like a Clown

episodes.synopsis: Michel Volban returns to the base of the People’s Army and introduces Cleo as their savior - but the pirate is concerned only with his reward.
episodes.title: Like a Rebuke

episodes.synopsis: Aristocratic forces perpetrate an all out offensive against the rebellion, and Cleo rallies the troops with his expert tactics. As the fires of war are flamed, a hero rises.
episodes.title: Like the Truth

episodes.synopsis: Shrewd political maneuvering could shape the outcome of the war, so both sides race across the stars to plead their case to a woman who holds much power and territory.
episodes.title: Like Constant Change

episodes.synopsis: B.B. plays the Holy Empire and the People’s Army against each other, but her eventual support may not matter. In a distant cathedral, a young lady struggles as politics and love clash.
episodes.title: Like a Demon

episodes.synopsis: As Vetti’s battleships remind the territorial lords of the consequences of siding with the People’s Army, he reveals the horrors that shaped him to his soon-to-be bride.
episodes.title: Like a Hungry Wolf

episodes.synopsis: War has erupted among the stars! Vetti proves that even peace can be used as a weapon, and when the seemingly unbreakable is shattered, the Holy Empire takes control.
episodes.title: Like the Setting Sun

episodes.synopsis: The history of Michel Volban’s desperate search for one that would lead the People’s Army is revisited, as well as Cleo and Vetti’s fateful first meeting.
episodes.title: Like a Labyrinth

episodes.synopsis: The People’s Army is no more. Michel is in Vetti’s custody and wounded Cleo wakes in prison under the watchful eye of the feared Doctor Muscat.
episodes.title: Like Daybreak

episodes.synopsis: Cleo’s escape plan finds a valuable ally hidden away in the prison. Meanwhile, with so much lost, Michel tries to escape the feeling that the revolution has failed.
episodes.title: Like Majesty

episodes.synopsis: Deep within the prison, Cleo hides with an old man who was banished by the Cross-Star Church.
episodes.title: Like an Epoch

episodes.synopsis: Cleo and the Admiral scour the hostile landscape for any means of escaping the planet. Meanwhile, Sylvia has infiltrated Vetti’s fortress - but freeing Michel may prove impossible.
episodes.title: Like Flight

episodes.synopsis: The old Admiral must find an escape route through the swarm of enemy ships choking the atmosphere. Sacrifices must be endured if victory is to be achieved.
episodes.title: Like a Lion

episodes.synopsis: Michel pilots Cleo’s ship across the stars, trying to break free of Vetti’s armada! Meanwhile, Pope Gorna reveals a shocking family secret to his daughter.
episodes.title: Like a Royal Road

episodes.synopsis: As the leaders of the People’s Army take shelter in BB’s territory, Vetti unleashes chaos on Bardeaux. When the smoke clears, a powerful new ally takes up arms.
episodes.title: Like a House of Cards

episodes.synopsis: Without the power of the territorial lords, Cleo can never hope to coax Vetti to the bargaining table. Amidst all the plotting, Michel reflects on a life lived in secret for the good of the people.
episodes.title: Like Scarlet

episodes.synopsis: Emperor Vetti has stormed off into space, searching for the answer to an unanswerable riddle! Cleo rushes to intercept the crazed aristocrat as Pope Gorna sets in motion a plan of his own.
episodes.title: Like Bloodshed

episodes.synopsis: The Imperial fleet moves to engage the growing People’s Army, both sides determined to achieve their goals despite the cost.
episodes.title: Like a Blood Edict

episodes.synopsis: As the galaxy swirls toward apocalypse, Cleo and Vetti - one seeking peace, the other only victory - clash in the final battle for freedom.
episodes.title: Like an Ovation
